run_server_errors_main: run the script to generate Boost MySQL server error code header files from C headers
parse_err_header: parse a MySQL or MariaDB error header file into a DataFrame of error number and symbol pairs
merge_mysql_errors: merge MySQL 5.x and 8.x error code DataFrames resolving symbol conflicts by preferring 8.x names
generate_error_ranges: split MySQL and MariaDB error codes into common shared codes and server-specific codes
render_common_server_errc: render a C++ enum header string for common server error codes shared between MySQL and MariaDB
